messages:
Priya Gupta: quick heads up — planning an off-hours maintenance on Dedicated GPU pools tonight 00:30–01:30 UTC. Need a short statuspage blurb + customer email template. Impact: container restarts, brief request throttling. @Sam Blake @Emilio Ramos any objections?

Deploy Bot: scheduled maintenance job 'dedicated-kernel-rollout' created for 2026-03-28T00:30:00Z. Estimated duration: 60m. Runbook: /runs/12345. Notifying oncall.

Sam Blake: sounds good. Proposed rollout plan: canary in us-west -> eu-west -> ap-south, 10m stagger. If canary latency p95 > 250ms for >2m or error rate >0.5%, hold and rollback.

Emilio Ramos: verified kernel + driver combo on staging. No model weights or db schema changes. Restart scope: inference containers only; KV cache persisted across restarts.

Priya Gupta: perfect. drafting comms below — please keep edits minimal so we can post.

Priya Gupta: ```statuspage
Summary: Short maintenance window for Dedicated GPU runtime.
Impact: Brief interruptions to inference requests and potential throttling for some customers. Dedicated reserved pools are expected to have minimal impact but may see short connection resets during container restarts.
Window: 2026-03-28 00:30 — 01:30 UTC
Updates: We'll post progress here and note completion when finished.
Contact: support@redwood.ai
```

Priya Gupta: ```email
Subject: Planned maintenance — Dedicated GPU runtime (Mar 28, 00:30–01:30 UTC)
Hi,
We will perform a planned maintenance on our Dedicated GPU runtime on Mar 28 from 00:30 to 01:30 UTC. During this window you may experience short interruptions to inference requests or transient throttling. If you have pinned runtime versions or reserved Dedicated pools, impact should be minimal, but connections may briefly reset.
No action is required on your side. If you run critical workloads that cannot tolerate brief restarts, reply and we can discuss scheduling alternatives or temporary capacity pins.
Thanks,
Redwood Support
```

Sam Blake: add one-line note to email about rollback/resume policy? e.g., "If we detect regressions during the canary, we'll pause and roll back to the prior runtime version."

Priya Gupta: added locally — final snippet below for posting. planning to post to statuspage at 00:20 UTC and send emails to affected customers at 00:45 UTC.

Emilio Ramos: I'll wire a canary dashboard (latency + 5xx) and add an alert that pings #eng-oncall. Also will push a console banner about potential transient errors.

Sam Blake: one more operational item — pinning: please include instructions in the post for how customers can request a runtime pin (support ticket link).

Priya Gupta: noted. support link included in templates. Thanks all — will post and monitor. :thumbsup:
notes: thread is a maintenance coordination for off-hours dedicated runtime kernel update; contains statuspage snippet and customer email template
